title: 20 再回瘴气平原21 瘴灵兽的秘密
content_zh:
轰隆轰隆的声音不断响起，大片大片的空间塌陷，一道道裂缝出现，这空间似乎非常的愤怒，容不及洛豪逃走，强烈的震动甚至让洛豪连站都站不稳。
洛豪知道如果自己逃不掉，就必定会被这坍塌给埋掉，最后死于非命。
所以洛豪神识沟通了混沌书，在一瞬间就进入了混沌书。
混沌书化为了一片纸页一样的东西，跟随着震动，进入了塌陷的空间之内。
这场震动足足持续了半柱香的时间，等了大约一炷香时间，洛豪才从混沌书中释放神识出去，探查周围的情况。
当探查周围都是灰蒙蒙的一片，到处都是瘴气的时候，洛豪知道自己已经回到了瘴气平原，于是，洛豪神识沟通了混沌书，从混沌书中出来了。
此时已经看不到鸿宇仙祖留下的遗迹了，而且鸿宇仙祖的元神也不知去向。
洛豪再次吞下一株瘴灵花，然后开始往前方走去。
四周静悄悄的，让洛豪惊奇的是他竟然没有看到一头瘴灵兽，本来洛豪还想的是要是能够碰到单独的瘴灵兽，就猎杀一些瘴灵兽，尤其是瘴灵兽那头上坚硬的角。
想到这里，洛豪忽然从储物袋中拿出之前被他砍杀的瘴灵兽的头颅。
鲜血已经凝固了，洛豪用手摸了摸瘴灵兽的角，硬邦邦的，就像是摸到了一块坚硬的石头一般。
洛豪的神识探测进入了瘴灵兽的角，感受到了瘴灵兽角有一股玄奥的气息，洛豪似乎有些明悟，也许这气息能让他明白为何瘴灵兽的角如此坚硬了，连黑蛛刀都砍不断。
洛豪开始坐在地上顿悟起来，一道道手势被洛豪打出，全身的真元也喷涌而出，凝聚成了真火，真火烧在了瘴灵兽的角上，发出刺啦的声音。
随着声音越来越强烈，洛豪的手势也越来越快，瘴灵兽的角终于开始融化起来，不过融化的十分的缓慢，每烧一次，瘴灵兽的角也只是融化掉一滴液体，直到洛豪的真火更加猛烈时，洛豪的脸色甚至已经出现了大汗，脸色也变得有些苍白起来，瘴灵兽的角才融化的快起来。
一道道金色的液体开始融化掉，然后慢慢凝结成金色的固体。
大约过了一个时辰，瘴灵兽的角总算被洛豪的真火给融掉了，然后一块正方形状的金色固体停留在了洛豪的手中，洛豪手一触碰就知道这金色固体十分的不简单了。
洛豪拿出黑蛛刀，然后吞下了几株真心草，等到真元恢复完成，就再次喷出真火，洛豪想的就是要把这金色固体融入到黑蛛刀中。
黑蛛刀开始不停的转动起来，仿佛遇到美味食物的饿狼一般，吞噬金色固体也吞噬的非常的快，洛豪不停的转换手势，等到洛豪的手势停了下来的时候，黑蛛刀已经完全融合了金色固体。
此时的黑蛛刀气息平和，颜色有三分之一为金色，三分之一为白色，三分之一为黑色，洛豪长啸一声，自己的炼器水平也更进了一步，只差一点点就要从入门跨入到初级了，不过洛豪知道就算差一点点，也没法突破了。
黑蛛刀已经成为了一把三色刀，刀尖竟然也是三种颜色混合起来的颜色。

刀的形状如一般的长刀一般，看起来没什么特别之处，但洛豪知道自己的黑蛛刀已经快要突破极品灵器了，洛豪肯定如果自己能够成为初级的炼器师，那么黑蛛刀就可以升级成为下品真器了。
将黑蛛刀握在手中，洛豪朝瘴气平原砍了一刀，也还是一击浮沉刀，一道远比之前的数丈还要更长一些的刀幕从洛豪的身前扩向了远处。
不用洛豪多想也知道这刀幕比之前袭击的距离更长了，而且威力也比之前强大了几倍，这瘴灵兽的角果然是好东西啊，洛豪甚至有种再次碰到瘴灵兽，不用投机取巧，就能正面砍断瘴灵兽的角的错觉。
在洛豪的浮沉刀过后，瘴气平原的地面上留下一道长长的沟壑，而且沟壑还暴露出一股凌厉的刀意和气势，普通的结真期修士一旦接触它，恐怕都会被这股凌厉的刀意和气势给击伤。
继续往前行，洛豪的神识总算探查到一头落单的瘴灵兽，这头瘴灵兽的实力也有结真后期，不过看它一副茫然的样子，洛豪估计这头瘴灵兽应该是之前成群结队来的瘴灵兽中被落下的。
这可是实验他的黑蛛刀的好机会啊，洛豪迅速的朝这头瘴灵兽冲了过去。
到了这头瘴灵兽的身前，洛豪二话不说，一刀劈出，黑蛛刀爆发出一道绚烂的刀虹，刀虹带着恐怖的气势和威压，轰向了这头结真后期的瘴灵兽。
这头瘴灵兽的反应也不慢，当洛豪的刀虹一发出之后，它就感应到了，随即发出一声嘶叫，爆发出恐怖的速度，往洛豪的刀虹撞击而来，瘴灵兽的攻击极为单调，似乎除了冲撞，也并没有其它的技能了。
砰的一声，洛豪的刀虹和瘴灵兽的角撞击在了一起，就好像两块坚硬的石头撞击一般，两股力量互相摩擦起来。
content_en:
The sound of rumbling and rumbling continued, large areas of space collapsed, and cracks appeared. This space seemed to be very angry, and there was no room for Luo Hao to escape. The strong vibrations even made Luo Hao unable to stand still.
Luo Hao knew that if he could not escape, he would be buried by the collapse and die violently.
Therefore, Luo Hao's spiritual consciousness communicated with the Book of Chaos and entered the Book of Chaos in an instant.
The Book of Chaos turned into something like a piece of paper, followed by the vibration, and entered the collapsed space.
The vibration lasted for half a stick of incense, and after waiting for about a stick of incense, Luo Hao released his consciousness from the book of chaos to explore the surrounding situation.
When the surrounding area was gray and filled with miasma, Luo Hao knew that he had returned to the miasma plain, so Luo Hao's spiritual consciousness communicated with the Book of Chaos and came out of the Book of Chaos.
At this time, the relics left by Immortal Ancestor Hongyu can no longer be seen, and the spirit of Immortal Ancestor Hongyu is also missing.
Luo Hao swallowed a miasma flower again, and then began to walk forward.
It was quiet all around, and Luo Hao was surprised that he didn't see a miasma spirit beast. Originally, Luo Hao thought that if he could encounter a single miasma spirit beast, he would hunt some miasma spirit beasts, especially the hard horns on the miasma spirit beast's head.
Thinking of this, Luo Hao suddenly took out the head of the miasma beast that he had killed before from his storage bag.
The blood had solidified, and Luo Hao touched the miasma spirit beast's horn with his hand. It was hard, as if he had touched a hard stone.
Luo Hao's spiritual consciousness entered the horn of the miasma beast, and he felt a mysterious aura from the horn of the miasma beast. Luo Hao seemed to have some understanding. Perhaps this aura could help him understand why the horn of the miasma beast was so hard that even the black spider knife could cut it without stopping.
Luo Hao began to sit on the ground and had an epiphany. Luo Hao made a series of hand gestures, and the real energy in his body spurted out, condensing into real fire. The real fire burned on the horns of the miasma spirit beast, making a stinging sound.
As the sound became stronger and stronger, Luo Hao's gestures became faster and faster, and the miasma spirit beast's horn finally began to melt, but the melting was very slow. Every time it was burned, the miasma spirit beast's horn only melted a drop of liquid. When Luo Hao's true fire became more intense, Luo Hao's face even started to sweat profusely, and his face became a little pale, and the miasma spirit beast's horn melted faster.
Lines of golden liquid began to melt, and then slowly condensed into a golden solid.
About an hour later, the miasma spirit beast's horn was finally melted away by Luo Hao's real fire, and then a square-shaped golden solid stayed in Luo Hao's hand. As soon as Luo Hao touched his hand, he knew that this golden solid was very special.
Luo Hao took out the Black Spider Knife, and then swallowed a few True Heart Grasses. When the true energy was restored, he sprayed out the real fire again. Luo Hao wanted to integrate this golden solid into the Black Spider Knife.
The black spider knife began to rotate non-stop, like a hungry wolf encountering delicious food. It devoured the golden solid very quickly. Luo Hao kept changing his gestures. When Luo Hao's gestures stopped, the black spider knife had completely merged with the golden solid.
At this time, the Black Spider Sword had a peaceful aura, one-third of its color was golden, one-third was white, and one-third was black. Luo Hao let out a loud roar, and his level of weapon refining had also taken a step forward. He was just a little bit closer to stepping from entry level to beginner level, but Luo Hao knew that even if he was just a little bit short, he wouldn't be able to break through.
The Black Spider Knife has become a three-color knife, and the tip of the knife is actually a mixture of three colors.
The shape of the knife is like an ordinary long knife, and it doesn't look like anything special, but Luo Hao knows that his Black Spider Sword is about to break through to the top level of a spiritual weapon. Luo Hao is sure that if he can become a junior weapon refiner, then the Black Spider Sword can be upgraded to a low-grade real weapon.
Hold the black spider knife in your hand, Luo Hao slashed towards the miasma plain, and also struck the floating knife. A sword screen that was much longer than the previous several feet expanded from Luo Hao to the distance.
Luo Hao didn't need to think too much to know that the distance of the sword screen was longer than the previous attack, and the power was several times more powerful than before. The horn of this miasma spirit beast was indeed a good thing. Luo Hao even had the illusion that he could cut off the miasma spirit beast's horn head-on when he encountered the miasma spirit beast again without taking any chances.
After Luo Hao's floating sword passed by, a long ravine was left on the ground of the Miasma Plain, and the ravine also revealed a sharp sword intention and aura. Once ordinary Jiezhen monks came into contact with it, they would probably be injured by this sharp sword intention and aura.
Continuing to move forward, Luo Hao's spiritual consciousness finally detected a lone miasma spirit beast. The strength of this miasma spirit beast was also at the late stage of Jie Zhen. However, looking at its dazed look, Luo Hao estimated that this miasma spirit beast should have been left behind among the miasma spirit beasts that came in groups before.
This was a good opportunity to test his black spider knife. Luo Hao quickly rushed towards the miasma spirit beast.
Arriving in front of the miasma spirit beast, Luo Hao slashed out without saying a word, and the black spider sword burst out with a brilliant sword rainbow. With terrifying momentum and pressure, Luo Hao blasted towards the miasma spirit beast in the late stage of the Realization.
The miasma spirit beast's reaction was not slow either. When Luo Hao's sword rainbow was released, it sensed it, and then let out a scream, bursting out with terrifying speed, and collided with Luo Hao's sword rainbow. The miasma spirit beast's attack was extremely monotonous, and it seemed to have no other skills except collision.
With a bang, Luo Hao's sword rainbow and the miasma spirit beast's horn collided together, just like two hard stones colliding, and the two forces rubbed against each other.
